# OptiMantra

> > OptiMantra is a comprehensive EMR, CRM, and practice management platform designed for integrative, functional, and specialized healthcare practitioners.

OptiMantra provides industry-specific EHR solutions for diverse medical modalities including integrative medicine, behavioral health, primary care, acupuncture, and med spa practices. The platform emphasizes clinical integrations, telehealth capabilities, and regulatory compliance (HIPAA, PHIPA) while supporting e-prescribing, patient engagement, and practice management workflows.

## Key Topics

- EMR/EHR Software
- Practice Management
- Patient Portal
- E-prescribing (eRx, EPCS)
- Telehealth
- HIPAA Compliance
- Integrative Medicine
- Functional Medicine
- Clinical Integrations
- Inventory Management
- Insurance Billing
- Patient Engagement
- CRM Platform
- Direct Primary Care
- Multi-specialty Support

## Core Platform

- [OptiMantra Home](https://optimantra.com): OptiMantra homepage: EMR, CRM, and practice management for integrative practitioners
- [Features](https://optimantra.com/features): OptiMantra core features: SOAP charting, telehealth, e-prescriptions, diagnostics
- [About OptiMantra](https://optimantra.com/about-us): Company background: Nashville-based EHR platform for integrative medicine practitioners

## Modalities & Specialties

- [Modalities Overview](https://optimantra.com/modalities): OptiMantra modalities overview: integrative medicine, functional medicine, medispa platforms
- [Integrative and Functional Medicine EMR](https://optimantra.com/modalities/integrative-and-functional): EMR for integrative/functional medicine with supplement inventory and lab integrations
- [Behavioral Health and Psychiatry EMR](https://optimantra.com/modalities/behavioral-health-and-psychiatry): Specialized EMR for behavioral health and psychiatry with e-prescribing and assessments
- [Primary Care and Urgent Care EMR](https://optimantra.com/modalities/direct-primary-urgent-care): Primary care EMR with patient portal, telehealth, and billing automation
- [Med Spa EMR Software](https://optimantra.com/modalities/medspa): Med spa and aesthetic clinic management with appointment, inventory, and patient engagement
- [Acupuncture and Musculoskeletal EMR](https://optimantra.com/modalities/musculoskeletal-and-acupuncture): Acupuncture and TCM EMR with specialized charting and patient management
- [Multi-Modality EMR Software](https://optimantra.com/modalities/multi-modality): All-in-one EMR for multi-disciplinary clinics with diverse treatment modalities
